QUOTE: "With that callback wired, the only calls refused at approval are the ones that hit the deny list later. This contradicts the header's "default-deny" wording (`permission_manager.h`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes that an unmatched tool is approved by the callback and only the deny list blocks, so the effective posture is not default-deny, and unlisted tools run.
